high_kingdom_of_lindon.name: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_name}High Kingdom of Lindon
high_kingdom_of_lindon.description: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_desc}The green land west of the Blue Mountains, last realm of the High Elves on the shores of Middle-earth. From the Grey Havens of Mithlond the white ships sail into the West. Círdan the Shipwright, eldest of the Eldar, keeps the fading light of the Noldor — wise, few, and each blade irreplaceable. Lindon shares the Noldor strength of Imladris.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_bonus_1}+20% village hearth growth (The Last Homely House)

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_su_2_name}Mithlond Sentinel
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_su_2_desc}Heavy Noldor guardian of the Grey Havens.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_0_name}Elven Wisdom
perks.description: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_0_desc}+35% influence awarded on army success — the Wise know how to lead.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_1_name}The Last Homely House
perks.description: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_1_desc}+20% village hearth growth and -15% party food consumption.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_2_name}Woodland Grace
perks.description: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_perk_2_desc}+10% party speed in forest and +0.5 settlement loyalty per day.

strengths: {=taom_faction_high_kingdom_of_lindon_strength_1}Wise leadership reaps greater influence from victory

clans_of_forochel.name: {=taom_faction_clans_of_forochel_name}Clans of Forochel
clans_of_forochel.description: {=taom_faction_clans_of_forochel_desc}Scattered Orc tribes in the frozen northern wastes near the Ice Bay of Forochel. Savage raiders who prey on the Lossoth and any who venture north.

goblins_of_blue_craig.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_name}Goblins of Blue Craig
goblins_of_blue_craig.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_desc}A distinct goblin host of the Blue Mountains (Ered Luin) in the far west, hard by the Grey Havens of Lindon — a realm apart from their Misty Mountains cousins of Goblin Town. Same numberless, ill-armed swarms: weak alone, overwhelming in the mass, and ravenous on the march. They trouble the Elves of the western shore.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_su_0_name}Crag Goblin Skirmisher
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_su_0_desc}Numberless bow-armed rabble of the high crags.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_0_name}Goblin Swarm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_0_desc}+40% party size and +25% village volunteer respawn — weak but numberless.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_1_name}Tunnel-Runners
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_1_desc}+10% party speed on snow — goblins know every crag and tunnel.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_2_name}Ravenous Swarm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_blue_craig_perk_2_desc}The horde devours everything — +20% party food consumption.

remnants_of_angmar.name: {=taom_faction_remnants_of_angmar_name}Remnants of Angmar
remnants_of_angmar.description: {=taom_faction_remnants_of_angmar_desc}The dread realm of the Witch-king of Angmar in the far north. From his fortress of Carn Dum, the Witch-king wages war upon the remnants of Arnor.

kingdom_of_arthedain.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_arthedain_name}Kingdom of Arthedain
kingdom_of_arthedain.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_arthedain_desc}The last and greatest of the successor kingdoms of Arnor. Arthedain held out longest against the Witch-king of Angmar before its final fall.

kingdom_of_rhudaur.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rhudaur_name}Kingdom of Rhudaur
kingdom_of_rhudaur.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rhudaur_desc}The wild hill country of Rhudaur, easternmost of Arnor's successor kingdoms. Fell under the influence of Angmar and its hill-men serve the Witch-king.

kingdom_of_ered_duin.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_ered_duin_name}Kingdom of Ered Duin
kingdom_of_ered_duin.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_ered_duin_desc}The Dwarven mansions of the Blue Mountains, ancestral halls of Durin's Folk. After the loss of Erebor, many Dwarves found refuge here before Thorin's quest.

kingdom_of_cardolan.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_cardolan_name}Kingdom of Cardolan
kingdom_of_cardolan.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_cardolan_desc}The successor realm of Cardolan, once part of the great kingdom of Arnor. Now a land of scattered settlements and ancient barrows haunted by wights.

goblins_of_goblin_town.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_name}Goblins of Goblin Town
goblins_of_goblin_town.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_desc}The teeming goblin-warrens beneath the High Pass of the Misty Mountains. Since the fall of the Great Goblin the tribes have multiplied without number — vast, ill-armed swarms that win by sheer weight and breed faster than any foe can cull them. They run swiftest over the snows of their mountain home, but such hordes are ever ravenous.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_su_0_name}Goblin-town Spearman
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_su_0_desc}Massed spear-fodder of the High Pass warrens.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_0_name}Goblin Swarm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_0_desc}+40% party size and +25% village volunteer respawn — goblins are weak but numberless.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_1_name}Tunnel-Runners
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_1_desc}+10% party speed on snow — goblins know every pass and tunnel of the Misty Mountains.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_2_name}Ravenous Swarm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_goblins_of_goblin_town_perk_2_desc}Such a horde devours everything — +20% party food consumption.

overlordship_of_gundabad.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_name}Overlordship of Gundabad
overlordship_of_gundabad.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_desc}Mount Gundabad, sacred to the Pale Orcs of Bolg's lineage. Vast warbands march from the high passes — Orc Horde discipline rallies hosts for almost no influence, Mountain Marauders rule the snows, and Plunder Demands keep every warlord paid.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_bonus_6}+1 Artisan + 3 Gang Leader notables per town (Bone-Smiths, Pale Warband Chieftains)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_0_name}Orc Horde
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_0_desc}Army influence cost reduced by 40% — dread compels obedience.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_1_name}Mountain Swarm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_1_desc}+20% party size limit and +10% party speed on snow.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_2_name}Pale Warband Chieftains
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_perk_2_desc}+3 Gang Leader and +1 Artisan notable per town — recruitment swells with raiders.

weaknesses: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_gundabad_weakness_2}Dwarves and Elves hate the Pale Orcs

kingdom_of_imladris.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_name}Kingdom of Imladris
kingdom_of_imladris.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_desc}Elrond's hidden valley, sanctuary of the Wise. Elven Wisdom unifies armies at little influence cost; the Last Homely House grows hearths in every village. Elven Pride still drives every council — every Noldor blade is irreplaceable.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_bonus_1}+20% village hearth growth (The Last Homely House)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_0_name}Elven Wisdom
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_0_desc}+35% influence awarded on army success — the Wise know how to lead.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_1_name}The Last Homely House
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_1_desc}+20% village hearth growth and -15% party food consumption.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_2_name}Woodland Grace
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_imladris_perk_2_desc}+10% party speed in forest — the trees of Imladris part for their kin.

kingdom_of_moria.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_name}Orcs of the Misty Mountains
kingdom_of_moria.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_desc}The orc-host that holds the deep places of the Misty Mountains — the black pits of Moria, won from the Dwarves, and the cold peaks from Caradhras to Methedras. Larger and better-armed than the goblin rabble of the High Pass, they muster vast war-hosts for almost no influence and march hungry but tireless across the snows.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_0_name}Moria Orc Warrior
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_0_desc}Heavier orc infantry of the deep halls.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_1_name}Moria Pit-archer
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_1_desc}Bow-orc of the deep halls and high tunnels.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_2_name}Black Pit Marauder
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_su_2_desc}Raider bred in the dark of Khazad-dûm.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_0_name}Orc Horde
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_0_desc}Army recruitment costs 40% less influence — the orc-host needs no consensus to march.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_1_name}Mountain Host
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_1_desc}+30% party size and +10% speed on snow — large war-hosts bred to the cold peaks.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_2_name}Hungry Host
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_moria_perk_2_desc}A war-host of this size eats greedily — +15% party food consumption.

anduin_vale.name: {=taom_faction_anduin_vale_name}Anduin Vale
anduin_vale.description: {=taom_faction_anduin_vale_desc}The fertile valley of the Great River Anduin, home to the Beornings and Woodmen. Simple folk who live between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood.

kingdom_of_lothlorien.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_name}Kingdom of Lothlorien
kingdom_of_lothlorien.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_desc}The Golden Wood, realm of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn. Wardens of Lorien defend the mallorn-forests cheaply; Lembas Bread sustains every march; Elven Harmony keeps morale unshakable. Timeless Craft means every change is slow.

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_su_2_name}Silver Sentinel
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_su_2_desc}Heavy Elven guardian of the Golden Wood.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_0_name}Power of Nenya
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed in forest and -20% garrison wage.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_1_name}Lembas Bread
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_1_desc}-15% party food consumption — one bite carries a marching elf a day.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_2_name}Elven Harmony
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lothlorien_perk_2_desc}+3 party morale and +0.5 loyalty per day in every settlement.

wildmen_of_enedwaith.name: {=taom_faction_wildmen_of_enedwaith_name}Wildmen of Enedwaith
wildmen_of_enedwaith.description: {=taom_faction_wildmen_of_enedwaith_desc}The wild lands of Enedwaith between Arnor and Gondor. Home to scattered clans of Men who answer to no king, living as hunters and herders.

clans_of_dunland.name: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_name}Clans of Dunland
clans_of_dunland.description: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_desc}The Hill-Men of Dunland, ancient enemies of the Rohirrim. Battanian forest traditions blend with TAOM's Hill Marchers and Hill-Tribe Levies — cheap, fast, angry warbands that march on plain and forest alike. Battanian smiths are slow, but warbands are not.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_bonus_0}50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight range (Battanian-borrowed)
{=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_bonus_4}+20% chance for veteran militia in towns (Battanian-borrowed)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_0_name}Hill Marchers
perks.description: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed on plains and +5% party size — Dunlending warbands cover ground fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_1_name}Hill-Tribe Recruitment
perks.description: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_1_desc}+10% village volunteer respawn rate — villages refill with cousins fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_2_name}Battanian Forest Lineage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_perk_2_desc}Borrowed 50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight, and +20% chance for veteran militia in towns; -10% construction speed.

dominion_of_isengard.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_name}Dominion of Isengard
dominion_of_isengard.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_desc}Saruman's industrial fortress at Orthanc. The Ring of Isengard runs day and night — Uruk-hai legions, forge-line crossbows, war wargs. Isengard's one town swells to twenty notables: a recruitment hub equal to many cities of Rohan. Saruman's Grip alienates every neighbor.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_bonus_3}-15% mounted recruit and upgrade cost (War Wargs)
{=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_bonus_6}+10% party speed on plains and swamps (Forced March, Fenland Drillmasters)
{=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_bonus_7}+2 Merchant + 1 Artisan + 12 Gang Leader notables in Isengard town (20 total)

special_units.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_su_2_name}Warg Rider
special_units.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_su_2_desc}Fast hit-and-run cavalry of the White Hand.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_0_name}Uruk-hai Legions
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_0_desc}+20% party size limit and +10% march speed on plain and swamp.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_1_name}Industrial Might
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_1_desc}+15% construction, -20% smithing energy, -15% mounted recruitment cost.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_2_name}Orthanc Quartermasters
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_perk_2_desc}Isengard's single town swells to 20 notables — 4 Merchant, 2 Artisan, 14 Gang Leader.

kingdom_of_lasgalen.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_name}Kingdom of Lasgalen
kingdom_of_lasgalen.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_desc}Thranduil's Woodland Realm in northern Mirkwood. Silvan archers and veteran militia hold the great forest against spider, orc, and shadow. Woodland Sustenance keeps the supplies light; Woodland Bonds keep morale high. Forest isolation slows growth.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_0_name}Woodland Realm
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed in forest and -15% food consumption.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_1_name}Silvan Wardens
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_1_desc}+25% chance militia recruits arrive as veterans.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_2_name}Woodland Bonds
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_lasgalen_perk_2_desc}+3 party morale — Silvan elves march with songs.

kingdom_of_erebor.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_name}Kingdom of Erebor
kingdom_of_erebor.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_desc}The Lonely Mountain reclaimed. Master Smiths cut smithing energy by 30%; Dwarven Honor adds loyalty every day; Dwarven Stubbornness keeps morale unshakable. Slow to build a wall — but the wall holds until the mountain itself falls.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_0_name}Master Smiths
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_0_desc}-30% smithing energy cost — Dwarven forges work twice as fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_1_name}Dwarven Garrison
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_1_desc}-25% garrison wage and +1 settlement loyalty per day.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_2_name}Dwarven Stubbornness
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_erebor_perk_2_desc}+5 party morale and +10% village production — Dwarves do not bend.

kingdom_of_dale.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_name}Kingdom of Dale
kingdom_of_dale.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_desc}Bard's rebuilt city beneath Erebor. Inherited Sturgian grain abundance and Sturgian cheap-army tradition pair with TAOM's Vale Traders plain-speed bonus — but Sturgian kingdom-decision penalties cut both ways. A thriving trade alliance with the Dwarves keeps Dale rich and ready.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_bonus_3}+20% relationship penalty from kingdom decisions (Sturgian, inherited)
{=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_bonus_6}-0.5 settlement loyalty per day (Small Territory Exposure)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_0_name}Vale Traders
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed on plains — caravans of Lake-town move fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_1_name}Dwarven Alliance
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_1_desc}Trade with Erebor provides bonus income and arms-supply.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_2_name}Sturgian Grain & Army Lineage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dale_perk_2_desc}Inherited Sturgian +10% village grain and -50% army influence cost; relationship penalty +20% on kingdom decisions.

kingdom_of_neldoreth.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_neldoreth_name}Kingdom of Neldoreth
kingdom_of_neldoreth.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_neldoreth_desc}An Elven realm in the northern reaches of Mirkwood, where the Wood-elves maintain their ancient forests against the creeping darkness from the south.

overlordship_of_dol_guldur.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_name}Overlordship of Dol Guldur
overlordship_of_dol_guldur.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_desc}The Necromancer's southern hold in Mirkwood. Shadow Command rallies hordes at almost no influence; Dark Conscription drills militia veterans; Shadow Captains swell the one town to twenty notables. Voracious Hordes eat as much as they slay.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_4}+1 Merchant + 1 Artisan + 13 Gang Leader notables in Dol Guldur town (20 total)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_0_name}Shadow Command
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_0_desc}Army influence cost reduced by 50% — dread compels obedience.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_1_name}Dark Legions
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_1_desc}+20% party size and +20% volunteer respawn rate.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_2_name}Shadow Captains
perks.description: {=taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_2_desc}Dol Guldur's single town fields 20 notables — a 15 Gang Leader recruitment hub.

kingdom_of_dorwinion.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dorwinion_name}Kingdom of Dorwinion
kingdom_of_dorwinion.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_dorwinion_desc}The wine-growing realm of Dorwinion on the northwestern shores of the Sea of Rhun. A prosperous trading kingdom caught between the Free Peoples and the East.

kingdom_of_rohan.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_name}Kingdom of Rohan
kingdom_of_rohan.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_desc}The Riddermark of the Horse-lords. Horse-lord Heritage cheapens every mounted recruit and upgrade; Riders of the Mark cuts mounted wages; Horse-lord Fellowship binds the Mark in loyalty. Cavalry Dependent — parties heavy with infantry slow to a crawl.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_bonus_2}-15% mounted troop wages (Riders of the Mark)
{=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_bonus_3}+10% party speed on plains (Riders of the Plains)
{=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_bonus_6}-10% party speed when over 50% infantry (Cavalry Dependent)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_0_name}Horse-lord Heritage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_0_desc}-15% cost to recruit AND upgrade mounted troops — the Mark trains riders cheaply.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_1_name}Riders of the Mark
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_1_desc}-15% mounted troop wages and +10% party speed on plains.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_2_name}Horse-lord Fellowship
perks.description: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_perk_2_desc}+5 party morale and +0.5 settlement loyalty per day.

weaknesses: {=taom_faction_kingdom_of_rohan_weakness_2}Helm's Deep is exposed when the Mark rides out

stewardship_of_gondor.name: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_name}Stewardship of Gondor
stewardship_of_gondor.description: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_desc}The last bastion of the Dunedain in the south. Tower Guard hold the line, Gondorian Discipline rallies armies cheaply, and the Men of the Fields march on plains. War-Depleted Lands grow slowly — but Gondor stands.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_bonus_0}+10% party speed on plains (Men of the Fields)
{=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_bonus_5}+1 settlement loyalty per day (Tower Guard Discipline)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_0_name}Tower Guard Discipline
perks.description: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_0_desc}-20% garrison wage and +1 settlement loyalty per day.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_1_name}Gondorian Resolve
perks.description: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_1_desc}+5 party morale and +30% army influence awarded on success.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_2_name}Men of the Fields
perks.description: {=taom_faction_stewardship_of_gondor_perk_2_desc}+10% party speed on plains and +2.5% party size — the Pelennor is open ground.

dominion_of_mordor.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_name}Dominion of Mordor
dominion_of_mordor.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_desc}Sauron's Black Land. The Dark Lord's Will lets armies muster at minimal influence cost; Nurn Farmlands feed the hordes; Sauron's Wrath turns raids into slaughter; Creatures of the Dark march faster at night than any free people in daylight. Dark Tribute drains the treasury.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_bonus_0}-60% army influence cost (The Dark Lord's Will)
{=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_bonus_4}+10% party speed at night (Creatures of the Dark)
{=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_bonus_5}+5% party speed on plains and swamps (Shadow March, Dead Marshes)
{=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_bonus_7}+2 Gang Leader notables per town (Black Speech Heralds)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_0_name}The Dark Lord's Will
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_0_desc}Army influence cost reduced by 60% — Sauron's hordes need no consensus.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_1_name}Sauron's Wrath
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_1_desc}+25% raid damage and +5% party speed on plains and swamps.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_2_name}Creatures of the Dark
perks.description: {=taom_faction_dominion_of_mordor_perk_2_desc}+10% party speed at night — the eyes of Mordor never sleep.

golden_realm_of_rhun.name: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_name}Golden-Realm of Rhun
golden_realm_of_rhun.description: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_desc}The Easterlings of the eastern plains. Inherited Khuzait cavalry traditions paired with TAOM's Easterling Outriders steppe speed and Easterling Host party size. Heavy cavalry that arrives in numbers and tribute.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_bonus_2}-10% mounted recruit and upgrade cost (Khuzait, inherited)
{=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_bonus_3}+25% horse, mule, cow, and sheep village production (Khuzait, inherited)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_0_name}Easterling Outriders
perks.description: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed on steppe — riders of the Sea of Rhun cross the plain fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_1_name}Easterling Host
perks.description: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_1_desc}+5% party size limit — hordes muster in answer to Mordor's call.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_2_name}Khuzait Steppe Lineage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_golden_realm_of_rhun_perk_2_desc}Inherited Khuzait -10% mounted cost, +25% animal village production; -20% town tax income.

stronghold_of_narager.name: {=taom_faction_stronghold_of_narager_name}Stronghold of Narager
stronghold_of_narager.description: {=taom_faction_stronghold_of_narager_desc}A desolate eastern region overrun by Orc tribes. These savage bands raid the borderlands and serve as scouts for the forces of darkness.

khudorom_of_khand.name: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_name}Khudorom of Khand
khudorom_of_khand.description: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_desc}The Variag of Khand. Battanian forest militia traditions inherited; TAOM's Steppe Charioteers add +10% party speed on steppe on top. Mercenary bands ride for whoever pays the most coin.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_bonus_1}50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight range (Battanian, inherited)
{=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_bonus_2}+20% chance for veteran militia in towns (Battanian, inherited)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_0_name}Steppe Charioteers
perks.description: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed on steppe — Variag chariots roll fast.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_1_name}Mercenary Tradition
perks.description: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_1_desc}Mercenary captains ride for whoever pays — but they keep their cut.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_2_name}Battanian Forest Lineage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_perk_2_desc}Inherited 50% less forest speed penalty + 15% sight range and +20% chance for veteran militia in towns; -10% construction speed.

weaknesses: {=taom_faction_khudorom_of_khand_weakness_2}Mercenary captains are loyal to coin, not lord

stronghold_of_ered_gwaer.name: {=taom_faction_stronghold_of_ered_gwaer_name}Stronghold of Ered Gwaer
stronghold_of_ered_gwaer.description: {=taom_faction_stronghold_of_ered_gwaer_desc}A region dominated by savage Orc tribes from the eastern mountains. Fierce raiders who terrorize the borderlands between Khand and Harad.

taskralan_of_harwan.name: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_name}Taskralan of Harwan
taskralan_of_harwan.description: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_desc}The Haradrim of Harwan, sons of the sun. Aserai desert resilience inherited; TAOM's Sons of the Sun add +10% party speed on desert; Haradrim Warbands add party size on top of the inherited caravan economy. Mumakil rule the southern plains.

bonuses.text: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_bonus_0}+10% party speed on desert (Sons of the Sun)
{=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_bonus_2}-30% caravan build cost + -10% trade penalty (Aserai Trader, inherited)
{=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_bonus_3}No speed penalty on desert (Aserai Desert, inherited)

perks.name: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_0_name}Sons of the Sun
perks.description: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_0_desc}+10% party speed on desert — born to burning sands.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_1_name}Haradrim Warbands
perks.description: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_1_desc}+5% party size limit — tribal warbands ride together to Mordor's call.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_2_name}Aserai Desert Lineage
perks.description: {=taom_faction_taskralan_of_harwan_perk_2_desc}Inherited Aserai Trader (-30% caravans, -10% trade penalty) and Aserai Desert (no desert speed penalty); +5% daily wages.

havens_of_umbar.name: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_name}Havens of Umbar
havens_of_umbar.description: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_desc}The corsair haven and Black Numenorean port-city on the southern bays. Corsair Trade slashes caravan costs, Corsair Glory adds renown, Desert Corsairs march fast across the sands — but Corsair Greed inflates every wage bill.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_0_name}Corsair Trade
perks.description: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_0_desc}-25% caravan cost and +15% tariff income — Umbar prospers on every passing ship.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_1_name}Corsair Glory
perks.description: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_1_desc}+8% renown per battle — the corsair name is sung in every port.

perks.name: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_2_name}Desert Corsairs
perks.description: {=taom_faction_havens_of_umbar_perk_2_desc}+10% party speed on desert — Umbar's marches cross sand as easily as sea.

aru_thani_of_bellakar.name: {=taom_faction_aru_thani_of_bellakar_name}Aru-Thani of Bellakar
aru_thani_of_bellakar.description: {=taom_faction_aru_thani_of_bellakar_desc}The coastal realm of Bellakar, settled by Numenorean Faithful who remained true to the Valar. A bastion of civilization on the southern shores.
